name: Tsuukin Kairaku 2 ~Chikan de Go! Go!~
source:
Main character is an office worker who has to get to work by the second most popular train line among molesters.
One morning he gets in a packed train with his hand pressed against his colleague body. He withdraws his hand, but feels body sensation from the move. From that moment life of an ordinary salary-man starts to change.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名公司职员，每天必须搭乘痴汉人气排名第二的电车线路上班。
某天早晨，他挤进拥挤车厢，手掌被压在女同事身上。他立刻把手抽回，却从刚才的动作中感受到身体触感。从这一刻起，普通上班族的人生开始改变。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
